resources.string: Open LocalMix on your phone to sign in
LocalMix could not tell what that link is
Choose the language used by LocalMix.
Shapes the sound inside LocalMix, before it reaches the system.
Runs after LocalMix\'s, on the whole audio session. Using both applies both.
First set LocalMix\'s battery usage to Unrestricted. Higher refresh rates use more battery, CPU and GPU, and may warm your device.
Enable only if LocalMix\'s battery use is set to Unrestricted. Android can still limit the refresh rate when the device is hot or low on power.
Point LocalMix at an addon server you host or were given a link to
Signing in opens Discord\'s login page. Nothing is typed into LocalMix.
Paste the addon’s URL - either its root or its manifest.json. LocalMix reads what it can search and stream, then asks it for tracks over plain HTTP.
If a source does not have a track or cannot be reached, LocalMix tries the next one. Sources above YouTube can replace its recording when they return a better version.
Listen a little more and LocalMix will turn your history into a Replay.
Point LocalMix at a WebDAV music folder - your Nextcloud Music directory or any server speaking WebDAV.
Point LocalMix at a shared music folder - a NAS or Windows share speaking SMB.
